outline:
本課程以介紹電腦在工程設計應用為主，內容有電腦輔助繪圖含電腦三維實體模型建立、電腦模擬、最佳設計、有限元素分析等。
This course introduces the computer aided engineering techniques applied in mechanical engineering design. The course contents will include topics on computer aided design and draft including the creation of 3D solid model, computer simulation, Optimization technique, and finite element analysis techniques
schedule:
1. Course description and syllabus
2. Introduction of linkages, cams, and gears
3. Gym visitation
4. Linkages design 1
5. Linkages design 2
6. Presentation 1: Motivation and case study of the topic.
7. Presentation 2: Motion requirements and the major parameters
8. Motion simulations 1
9. Motion simulations 2
10. Presentation 3: Modification and the design (Drawing CAD parts)
11. Presentation 4: Motion simulation of the design
12. Static analysis 1
13. Static analysis 2
14. Dynamic analysis
15. Questions and troubleshoot
16. Presentation 5: Static analysis on critical positions
17. Submit the final report
assessment:
Project presentation: 40%
Assignments and Quizzes :30%
Final report: 30%
